commercial_product.note: Bausch Health is largely a commercial-stage diversified specialty pharma (Salix GI, Bausch + Lomb eye health, Solta Medical, International, Diversified). Major marketed products include Xifaxan (rifaximin), Trulance, Relistor, Lumify, Blink, enVista IOLs, Thermage, CABTREO. ~80 R&D projects per 10-K; only late-stage clinical assets material to investors are listed above.
